input.quote: 3.1 The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation mechanic in either direction. The only commercial terms are the fixed revenue-share and payment mechanics in Article 3 (Sections 3.1-3.4), which set a flat 30% of Net Sales above a monthly threshold with no obligation on the Company to extend to HDI any better pricing, rates or terms granted to third parties, and no obligation to match third-party offers. Searches for "most favored", "no less favorable", "favorable", "price", "discount", "match" and "refusal" returned nothing. The Exclusivity provision (Section 6.1) restricts the Company from participating in similar internet projects for Deerskin Products, but that is a scope/exclusivity restraint rather than an MFN obligation to give HDI terms no less favourable than those given to others, so it is outside this rule. Consistent with the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), no redline is required.
